title: Image Classifier + Inference API
description: Train an image classifier from scratch on a public dataset, expose it as a FastAPI inference endpoint in Docker, and record per-class accuracy plus p50/p95 latency in an evaluation report a reviewer can re-run.
learningObjectives: Build a CNN training loop with augmentation and validation
Quantify per-class performance beyond top-line accuracy
Serve a model behind a typed HTTP API with input validation
Measure and report p50/p95 latency under a scripted load

milestones.title: Train CNN without pretraining
milestones.objective: Train a small CNN from scratch on a public dataset (e.g. CIFAR-10 subset) with augmentation and a validation split.
milestones.expectedOutput: Checkpoint plus a per-class accuracy table that beats a trivial baseline.

milestones.title: FastAPI inference endpoint
milestones.objective: Serve predictions with request validation, error handling, and a health endpoint.
milestones.expectedOutput: OpenAPI docs and passing API contract tests.

milestones.title: Container + load test
milestones.objective: Containerize the service and measure p50/p95 latency with a scripted 100-request load run.
milestones.expectedOutput: Latency table in the report and a reproducible load script.

milestones.title: Confusion analysis
milestones.objective: Analyze the confusion matrix; name the top two failure pairs and hypothesize causes.
milestones.expectedOutput: Confusion section in the evaluation report.

categories.minimumExpectation: Trained-from-scratch model with a per-class table

categories.excellentExpectation: Contract tests plus graceful degradation for bad input

categories.minimumExpectation: docker compose up serves the API
categories.excellentExpectation: Multi-stage build with slim image and runbook

architecture: tests/ (API contract tests with a tiny fixture model)
constraints: No pretrained weights in the final model
Deterministic response shape for empty and oversized inputs
hints: Serve with a fixed model version hash so the evaluation report and API output line up

requiredEvidence.description: Repository with training and service code.
OpenAPI/contract documentation link or in-repo file.
